recommendations.section: ## 5. Where to Publish: IEEE Conferences and Scopus Journals
recommendations.current: **Scopus journals.** Verify every journal yourself using the free Scopus Preview source list, searching **by ISSN, not title**. A coverage range ending in a past year means the title has likely been discontinued, so do not submit there [[how-to-verify-scopus-indexing-step-by-step-guide-2026]]. Scopus re-evaluates titles continually through an independent selection board and discontinues journals flagged for poor practice [[the-guardians-of-scopus]]. Re-check the status at acceptance, not only at submission.
recommendations.recommended:
**Scopus journals.** Verify every journal yourself before submitting:

- **Search by ISSN, not title,** in the free Scopus Preview source list [[how-to-verify-scopus-indexing-step-by-step-guide-2026]].
- **Check the coverage range.** A range ending in a past year means the title has likely been discontinued, so do not submit there [[how-to-verify-scopus-indexing-step-by-step-guide-2026]].
- **Re-check at acceptance, not only at submission.** Scopus re-evaluates titles continually through an independent selection board and discontinues journals flagged for poor practice [[the-guardians-of-scopus]].
recommendations.rationale: The paragraph is a three-step verification procedure, so a bold-labelled checklist lets a student follow it step by step. All citations are kept, and the shared citation appears on both steps it supports.
